title: EXPLAIN 计划格式化器：把逻辑计划打印成缩进树
code:
class Node:
    def __init__(self, label, children=None):
        self.label = label
        self.children = children or []

    def lines(self, prefix="", last=True, root=True):
        conn = "" if root else ("+- " if last else ":- ")
        out = [prefix + conn + self.label]
        nxt = prefix + ("" if root else ("   " if last else "|  "))
        for i, c in enumerate(self.children):
            out += c.lines(nxt, i == len(self.children) - 1, False)
        return out


def postorder(n, depth=0, acc=None):
    if acc is None:
        acc = []
    for c in n.children:
        postorder(c, depth + 1, acc)
    acc.append("  " * depth + n.label)
    return acc


def count(n):
    return 1 + sum(count(c) for c in n.children)


scan_o = Node("(0) Scan parquet orders [uid, amount, dept, dt]")
scan_u = Node("(1) Scan parquet users [uid, city]")
proj_o = Node("(2) Project [uid, amount, dept]", [scan_o])
bcast = Node("(3) BroadcastExchange HashedRelationBroadcastMode(List(input[0]))", [scan_u])
join = Node("(4) BroadcastHashJoin [uid], [uid], Inner, BuildRight", [proj_o, bcast])
agg = Node("(5) HashAggregate(keys=[dept], functions=[partial_sum(amount)])", [join])
root = Node("(6) AdaptiveSparkPlan isFinalPlan=false", [agg])

print('== explain(mode="formatted") ==')
for line in root.lines():
    print(line)

print("")
print("== 阅读顺序（后序遍历：自底向上，先看 Scan 再看算子） ==")
for line in postorder(root):
    print(line)

print("")
print("计划节点总数 = " + str(count(root)))
print("格式化输出行数 = " + str(len(root.lines())))
print("叶子（数据源）个数 = " + str(sum(1 for n in [scan_o, scan_u])))
